Composer\\Command.reason: the console commands: the Rust side runs its own, and plugin commands run in the worker under a genuine console application

Composer\\Console.reason: the console application: each side runs its own, the worker one hosting plugin commands

Composer\\Util\\Loop.reason: each side drives its own event loop over the jobs it started

Composer\\Util\\SyncHelper.reason: a helper over Loop, which each side drives on its own

Symfony\\Component\\Console.reason: the console component: each side has its own input, output and application objects
